notes.title: The 炸毛张 Release
notes.content:
The ghost no longer kills from a distance, she chases and has to physically catch you.  You'll know when she has heard you!

She is a little quicker to balance gameplay and the level layout has been tweaked to accommodate the new behaviour.

Keys are bathed in a bright blue light...and a few other tweaks.

notes.title: Yet another update!
notes.content: Light switches moved further from doors where both can be triggered at once.

notes.title: Screen resolution, again
notes.content: Hopefully fixed the screen resolution options.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Screen Res issues fixed.
Player's 'nightlight' removed - extended flashlight life is enough.
Added 'How To Play' guide to menu as this game is more of a thinker than it first appears.

notes.title: Window Mode Rollback
notes.content: I've had to rollback the Window Mode options as they are failing in Steam (but of course, work fine in my local version!).

notes.title: Removed excessive head bobbing in response to player feedback.
notes.content:
Removed excessive head bobbing in response to player feedback.

Apologies for any nausea caused!
